steps.name: Connecting card on first load
steps.goal: If a system alert such as Apple Account Verification is showing, tap Not Now. Tap Agree and continue if visible. Otherwise wait and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The app is visible behind a connection card with Boxy that reads Connecting…, and no title in the top bar says Reconnecting

steps.name: Connected when the first connect lands
steps.goal: Wait. Do not tap anything. The computer answers after about ninety seconds.

steps.name: Card closes by itself
steps.goal: If a sheet titled Your data and AI providers is showing, tap Agree and continue. Otherwise wait and do not tap anything.
steps.done: No connection card is on screen. Home shows its greeting and folder pills; the greeting does not say Reconnecting. Session rows may still be loading placeholders.
